name: telegram-readonly-mcp
description: Unofficial Telegram MCP for Codex. Read-only by default, optional sends/edits/deletions in explicitly allowed chats. Local authorization; no background notifications.

interface.shortDescription: Telegram for Codex; read-only by default.
interface.longDescription: Seven on-demand read tools; opt-in text sending, editing and deleting your own messages with a separate chat allowlist. Local session storage and authorization. Never monitors chats, shows message notifications or marks messages read.
defaultPrompt: Use Telegram MCP to list my chats.
Read unread messages and summarize tasks for me.
Search my Telegram chats for the requested topic.
